digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow and CI routing
propositions: Documentation-only patchsets must execute a reduced Verify lane containing only documentation-validation gates while skipping the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, identity, eval, and golden-path jobs

A trusted classifier job executing only from origin/main with the complete allowlist must decide the routing (docs-only vs full) based on changed paths, with fail-closed semantics for any uncertainty, parent-resolution failure, or classifier job failure
Documentation gates must be extracted once into a shared composite action at .github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml and invoked by both full and docs-only routes without duplicating command lists

The routing decision must be wired through vote.needs with explicit fail-closed gating so that classifier failure blocks Verified and prevents docs-only execution, while full-route jobs remain as fallback

All structural workflow consumers (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, and seven others) must be migrated to follow the extracted action and classifier outputs without losing existing assertions
Production proof must measure a genuine docs-only change (change 1786) and a genuine non-doc change (change 1789) to confirm reduced runner usage and complete full-route execution respectively
